## Objective
Create accurate, maintainable documentation for ClearGlass-Inc.

## Scope
- `README.md`
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- `CHANGELOG.md`
- Pull request template
- Issue templates

## Acceptance criteria
- Documentation reflects only verified repository behavior
- Includes setup, architecture, repository layout, environment variables, testing, and security practices
- No unsupported claims about products, customers, performance, certifications, or capabilities
- All instructions are executable and consistent with the codebase
